kaikki_vikisozluk.e: كُنْدُرَة or كُنْدَرَة • (kundura or kundara) f (plural كَنَادِر (kanādir))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Medieval Greek κονδοῦρα (kondoûra, “cutter”), originally referring to a kind of post-horse. For the word for “shoe” widespread in the dialects, it is supposedly only from Ottoman Turkish قوندورا (kundura) that it was acquired.
g: a kind of boat by which one picks up a ship’s crew landing e.g. the Maldives
